integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker verifies algebraic identities and source-example constants but is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compact invariant support in the strict positive quadrant; it does not establish existence for arbitrary parameters.
The Floquet formula is exact but its sign is not parameter-only without further information on the periodic orbit.
Boundary invariant measures are outside the stated scope.
title: Exact finite-amplitude mean and Floquet laws in an Allee–cooperation predator–prey cycle
